content: We need number of methyl (CH3) groups in the sample's molecule. We have no description of molecule. We can get NMR spectra to infer. Use proton NMR to see signals for CH3 (singlet, doublet, etc). Could also use carbon NMR. Probably easiest: get proton NMR and count distinct CH3 signals. But need number of methyl groups, not signals (could be overlapping). Could also use HSQC to map. But maybe the sample is known? No info. So we must request proton NMR spectra. Use tool proton_nmr_spectra.
